summary_1line: Krishna proposes a covert plan for Bhima to defeat the invincible Jarasandha, and Yudhishthira approves as the three heroes set out in disguise.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna, Bhima, and Arjuna depart together disguised as radiant Brahmanas, their warrior strength barely concealed as the people watch in awe.
Krishna speaks firmly before Yudhishthira and the Pandavas, declaring that only Bhima in personal combat can destroy the mighty Jarasandha.
From Girivraja, Jarasandha whirls a massive mace ninety-nine times and hurls it across the vast distance toward Mathura.
